name: labflow
description: Research and paper-work skills for Codex: evidence forensics, manuscript and figure craft, source-backed editorial guidance, PDF verification, and independent reviewers.

interface.shortDescription: Research and paper skills for Codex
interface.longDescription: Labflow adds literature and learning forensics, source-backed scientific editing, manuscript and scientific-figure guidance, traceable PDF evidence, and independent reviewers to the native Codex agent. Document, slide, PDF production, and image generation use host capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Use literature-forensics to investigate prior work on this mechanism.
Use paper-writing to align claims, evidence, figures, and page budget.
Use scientific-figures to validate statistics, units, print size, and editable sources.
